evidence: decorative_mascot: At seg2:start, seg2:mid and seg2:end Data stands on a crate pointing at the cube and never causes its faces to solve. At seg3:start he perches on a cube tower beside the stopwatch. At payoff@-0.4 he is alone holding a blank yellow price tag.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg4:end is a strong robot-arm cube shot. By payoff@-0.4 it has cut to a blank dark gradient with Data holding an empty price tag, so the video ends on a void. Through seg4 the headline reads '3.13 s fastest human hands', not the robot's 0.38 s that the closing line is about. The CTA text overlaps a corner cube.
weakest_scene.root_cause: After the closing scene ends, the render falls back to a default mascot end card (a blank price-tag prop on an empty ground) instead of holding the closing picture. The closing headline repeats the human number, and the corner prop cubes are placed under the CTA text.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Hold the finished closing shot (robot arm with a solved cube) to the last frame and remove the blank price-tag end card. Make the closing headline 0.38 s robot against 3.13 s human, and have Data fumbling his hand-held cube while the arm finishes. Move the corner cubes clear of the CTA line and render the CTA at full contrast from its first frame.
